messages:
maya: Heads-up — noticed growing queue depth for model 'code-small-quant' in ap-southeast1; per-slot backlog increased ~4x in the last 30m. GPU pslots showing starvation, PS CPU looks fine. Investigating.
oliver: seeing the same on grafana, dashboard here: https://grafana.redwood.io/d/queue/queue-depth?panelId=7 :eyes:
maya: logs show a burst of short requests (~20–50 tokens) coming from a single customer (acme-inc). Admission control isn't throttling because route is pinned to dedicated capacity + enterprise tier.
joel: that explains it. Can we apply a soft throttle for that customer while we triage?
anna: I can push a temporary frontend proxy rule to cap them to 50 rps for that route. Will deploy in ~3–5m.
sre-bot: Deploy started by anna (deploy/infra/frontend-proxy) — 1768501300
oliver: after deploy queue depth is trending down, but tail latency for in-flight requests bumped ~200ms. Some requests still accumulating in the model queue.
maya: proposing immediate overflow routing of acme-inc traffic to us-west2 small-quant pool until ap-southeast1 recovers. Need approval for cross-region fallback for enterprise routes.
joel: approve with conditions: ensure model version parity (v2) and verify KV-cache compatibility (same tokenizer, cache key schema). Also watch cost impact.
anna: done — created a fallback route and limited it to 30% of new connections; firewall/dns updates pushed. Config snippet: 
```
routes:
  - customer: acme-inc
    primary: ap-southeast1:code-small-quant:v2
    fallback: us-west2:code-small-quant:v2
    max_rps: 50
    fallback_pct: 30
```
maya: monitoring now — queue depth in ap-southeast1 back to baseline, us-west2 is accepting overflow and latency is stable. Will keep 30m watch.
oliver: can we add a short-lived metric/alert for cross-region fallbacks > 5% for a route? helps catch routing churn.
joel: yes, add metric and an alert that notifies eng-platform + cost team. Also we should have admission control respect dedicated reservations (i.e., soft caps only apply to shared pools).
maya: logging action items: 1) add per-customer soft limits in admission controller; 2) alert for fallback rate; 3) run capacity sweep for ap-southeast1 for next week; 4) post-incident writeup if this repeats.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421 — Queue spike ap-southeast1 (assigned: eng-sre)
anna: thumbs up. I'll keep the proxy limit for 1 hour and then we can relax if stable.
maya: thanks — nice quick work team. Will follow up with a short post in #incidents with graphs. :thumbsup:
